problem: Production /en/prijzen rendered the Dutch pricing H1 even though the route, locale metadata and exact-main deployment were correct.
root_cause: The pricing H1 is split by markup into separate DOM text nodes. Static i18n resolves those exact text-node sources, so a cache entry for only the visually concatenated H1 cannot translate the rendered heading.
prevention: Versioned cache patches for styled headings must cover the exact parser text-node sources, not only the visually concatenated sentence.
Keep the production browser gate asserting that /en/prijzen does not contain the Dutch H1 and does contain visible English Pricing copy.
Treat exact-main deployment proof and localized-content proof as separate terminal requirements.
Never report LIVE_BEWEZEN while an English route still contains a mandatory Dutch heading.

evidence.failure: English route still shows the Dutch pricing H1

evaluation.expected_invariant: the English pricing route never renders the Dutch pricing H1 and the versioned cache patch remains authoritative

semantic_learning.root_cause: Styled headings are translated node-by-node; sentence-level cache keys are insufficient when inline markup splits the text.
semantic_learning.prevention: Bind cache patches to the parser-level source strings and verify the visible composed result in a real browser.
semantic_learning.evidence: Production /en/prijzen reached the English route but visibly retained the Dutch composed H1.
